map.naruto-vs-sasuke.header.name: Naruto vs Sasuke
map.naruto-vs-sasuke.header.description: Naruto and Sasuke start in two villages of the Leaf. Below them the neutral Sunagakure and Kirigakure wait to be taken, each with its Kage set and its tailed beast; between them lies the Valley of the End, where Kurama and Gyuki guard the Rinnegan, Kusanagi and the First Hokage's Necklace. Defeat the other to win.
map.naruto-vs-sasuke.header.author: Naruto Heroes
